_why: ADR 0166's mutation table, re-derived under scripts/mutate.py.
ADR 0166 measures the domain classifier: the keyword table scores 60% on
a labelled set where the LLM scores 96%. Both of the defects it fixes are
the same shape -- a third state ('I could not determine this') collapsed
into a confident second state, so the pipeline kept answering and nothing
M1 restores the collapse in the classifier: the keyword table's fallback
reported as a genuine match. That is what made the baseline look accurate
on queries it had never understood -- every unrecognised query silently
M2 restores the collapse in the config check: provider keys present but
unselected, reported as 'no keys set'. That is the state a real
deployment was in, with five provider keys and no LLM_PROVIDER.
Not included, because these tests do not catch it: the stale Groq default
model. That was found by querying Groq's /v1/models over the network, and
no offline test asserts a remote model id still exists. A set file that
implied otherwise would overstate the evidence.
test: cd Science-Agent-Pipeline/artifacts/api-server && npx vitest run src/__tests__/classifierEval.test.ts src/__tests__/llmConfigState.test.ts

mutations.description: the keyword table's fallback reports itself as a genuine match
mutations._claimed: caught by the three-state tests and by the fallback count
mutations._note: The domain returned is unchanged -- still `mm` -- so every existing test that only asserts on the domain still passes. Only a test that asks whether a keyword actually matched can see this, which is the point: for as long as `matched` did not exist, this defect was invisible by construction.

mutations.description: provider keys present but unselected are reported as no keys at all
mutations._note: The operator-visible symptom of this mutation is a status line reading 'Not set' while five API keys sit in .env -- which sends whoever is debugging it to add a sixth key rather than to set LLM_PROVIDER. The pipeline keeps returning results the whole time, just classified by keyword.
